zh-CN.title: 绑定信息更安全
items: 已绑定的邮箱和手机号现在会脱敏展示，解绑操作也与绑定状态清晰分离
已认证数字 QQ 邮箱可在确认后直接绑定对应 QQ 号

en.title: Safer binding details
items: Bound email addresses and phone numbers are now masked, with unbinding separated from binding status
A verified numeric QQ email can now bind its matching QQ number after confirmation
